records.rationale: Examine both unique remerge-resolution hunks, not the 333 first-parent files. Binder unmapping resolution combines native check_vma ownership validation with Android before/after tracepoints; retain both in the final per-VMA-lock shrinker while preserving LTS mm mutex lifetime. Task-exit resolution keeps native kthread detection/exit before restored profile_task_exit, then native KCOV/KMSAN ordering. The latter has the concrete UID accounting notifier consumer in drivers/misc/uid_sys_stats.c and local framework /proc/uid_cputime and /proc/uid_io readers. No native kthread early-exit behavior is reordered or bypassed; ordinary task is live through its notifier. Later exit hooks are separate candidates, not unique changes attributed to this merge. Parents remain separately inventoried.

records.rationale: Retain Android VFS source-module namespace declarations and matching imports as a generic module policy, not historical ABI layout preservation. Entire patch mechanically checked: 82 export replacements plus 76 import additions and no other nonblank changed lines. Restore two imports lost during LTS filesystem reconciliation in 349c8bdc72bb; retain all remaining declarations except adapting vfs_splice_read to keep its native GPL-only flag while adding the namespace. ext4/F2FS are built in for SDK; those declarations also preserve their supported module configuration without adding a platform. Native modpost/loader check import declarations, not actual filesystem identity: this prevents accidental API use, not malicious trusted-module access. Four exports become GPL-only (kern_path,generic_file_open,kernel_read,kernel_write); retain that ACK source policy. Reject the opposite conversion for vfs_splice_read, which dropped the native GPL-only restriction; keep EXPORT_SYMBOL_NS_GPL. Namespace metadata does not replace native licensing checks. No vendor-binary compatibility promise. The retained namespace does not weaken VFS permission/data-integrity checks; function bodies are unaffected by this candidate. Build 102 passed; generated Module.symvers records vfs_splice_read as EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL in the retained namespace. All 145 generated module flag/CRC tables pass. Alternate allmodconfig and runtime module insertion are not claimed.

namespace_policy: Native explicit import validation is retained. It is not an access-control boundary against arbitrary loaded kernel code and does not prove a module is a filesystem. No kernel function body changed by this candidate.
validation: Full unique merge resolution read; native kthread ordering and profile notifier concrete consumers examined. Full namespace patch parsed with an exhaustive assertion rejecting any nonmetadata changed line, and every added declaration verified in current source with the explicit GPL-preserving vfs_splice_read adaptation. Build 101 covers imports; build 102 passed and confirms the final GPL flag in Module.symvers. No namespace runtime rejection, module insertion or filesystem-as-module build performed.
